g.text: Linear against quadratic covariance law on the same random draws
Fill: log2 of the RMSE under the single-cell law sum_j p_j R_j over the RMSE under the population law sum_j p_j^2 R_j,
the two bulks built from the same standard-normal draw; blue: the single-cell bulk is estimated better.
Grey contours: Gaussian overlap of the component laws N(mu_j, R_j) (MixSim, 5 levels), the same for both laws; it does not measure |rho_1 - rho_2|.
